LoadBus.Description: Tags of the buses whose loads are scaled by (1 + lambda). Usually given per call (LoadBus=...)

InitialLambda.Description: lambda at the starting point (the equilibrium)

Tolerance.Description: Convergence tolerance of the Newton-Raphson corrector

CorrectorMaxIteration.Description: Maximum number of iterations of the Newton-Raphson corrector

CorrectorStepSize.Description: Factor of the update of the Newton-Raphson corrector

Increment.Description: Step of the numerical Jacobian of the predictor and the corrector

UseInternalState.Description: Solve with the internal states of the generators
